templates.pattern: What is the angle between the hour hand and minute hand of a clock at [H]:[M]?
templates.explanation: At [H]:00 — Hour hand at [H]×30°. Minute hand at 0°. Angle = |[H]×30 - 0|. Min of that and 360 minus that.

templates.pattern: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands at [H]:[M]?
templates.explanation: Minute hand at 30×30/60=... Formula: |30H - 5.5M|. At [H]:30 = |30×[H] - 5.5×30| = |30[H] - 165|. Take min of result and 360-result.

templates.pattern: How many times do the hour and minute hands of a clock coincide in 12 hours?
templates.explanation: The hands coincide 11 times in every 12 hours (not 12, because at 12:00 it counts once). They meet at roughly 12:00, 1:05, 2:10, 3:16, 4:21, 5:27, 6:32, 7:38, 8:43, 9:49, 10:54.

templates.pattern: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
If today is [DAY], what day will it be after [N] days?
templates.explanation: [N] mod 7 = remainder. Add remainder to [DAY] to find the answer day.

templates.pattern: January 1, 2023 was a Sunday. What day was January 1, 2024?
templates.explanation: 2023 is not a leap year, so it has 365 days. 365 = 52×7 + 1. So 1 odd day. Sunday + 1 = Monday.

templates.pattern: How many odd days are in [Y] years (ordinary)?
templates.explanation: 1 ordinary year = 1 odd day. 2 years = 2 odd days. 3 years = 3 odd days. 4 years (with 1 leap) = 4+1=5 odd days = 0 odd days net (5 mod 7). 100 years = 5 odd days (24 leap years in 100 = 124 odd days = 5 mod 7... precise answer is 5). 200 years = 3 odd days.
answer_label: 2 (5 mod 7 = 5, but standard table: 4 years = 5 odd days)

templates.pattern: A clock gains [G] minutes every hour. If it shows the correct time at 12:00 noon, what time will it show at 6:00 PM the same day?
templates.explanation: 6 hours pass. Clock gains [G] minutes/hour × 6 hours = [G×6] minutes extra. So clock shows 6:00 PM + [G×6] minutes.

templates.pattern: What day of the week was 1st January 2000?
templates.explanation: 1st January 2000 was a Saturday. This is a standard reference date in calendar problems.

templates.pattern: At what time between [H]:00 and [H1]:00 do the hour and minute hands coincide?
Today is [DAY]. What day was it [N] days ago?
templates.explanation: [N] mod 7 = remainder. Subtract remainder from [DAY] (going back).

templates.pattern: How many times in a day do the hands of a clock form a right angle (90°)?
templates.explanation: The hands form a right angle 44 times in 24 hours (22 times in 12 hours × 2).

templates.pattern: A clock is set right at 10 AM. The clock loses [L] minutes every hour. What will the clock show at 10 PM the same day?
templates.explanation: 12 hours pass. Clock loses [L] min/hour × 12 = [L×12] minutes. Shows 10:00 PM - [L×12] minutes.

templates.pattern: If 15th August 1947 (India's Independence Day) was a Friday, what day of the week was 15th August 1948?
templates.explanation: 1948 is a leap year. From 15 Aug 1947 to 15 Aug 1948 = 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Friday + 2 = Sunday.

templates.pattern: What is the angle traced by the minute hand in [M] minutes?
templates.explanation: Minute hand moves 6° per minute. In [M] minutes = [M] × 6°.

templates.pattern: What is the angle traced by the hour hand in [H] hours?
templates.explanation: Hour hand moves 0.5° per minute = 30° per hour. In [H] hours = [H] × 30°.

templates.pattern: What day of the week will it be on [D] [MONTH] if 1st of that month is [DAY]?
templates.explanation: Day = 1st day + (D-1) mod 7. [D-1] mod 7 added to [DAY].

templates.pattern: A watch shows 4:30. The minute hand points East. In which direction does the hour hand point?
templates.explanation: At 4:30, angle between hands = |30×4 - 5.5×30| = |120 - 165| = 45°. Minute hand points East. Hour hand is 45° behind (clockwise). East - 45° clockwise = North-East direction.

templates.pattern: How many days are there from [D1] January to [D2] March of the same ordinary year (both dates inclusive)?
templates.explanation: January has 31 days, February has 28 (ordinary year), March has [D2] days included. Count = (31-D1+1) + 28 + D2.

templates.pattern: If the day after tomorrow is [DAY], what day is today?
templates.explanation: Day after tomorrow = today + 2. So today = [DAY] - 2 days.

templates.pattern: How many times in a 12-hour period are the hour and minute hands exactly opposite (180° apart)?
templates.explanation: The hands are exactly opposite 11 times in 12 hours.

templates.pattern: If [MONTH] [D], [Y] is a [DAY1], what day will [MONTH] [D1], [Y] be?
templates.explanation: (D1-D) mod 7 gives extra days. Add to [DAY1] to find the answer.

templates.pattern: How many leap years are there between [Y1] and [Y2] (both inclusive)?
templates.explanation: Leap year: divisible by 4, except century years must be divisible by 400. Count leap years in range [Y1] to [Y2].

templates.pattern: A clock shows 8:20. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
What will be the day of the week on [D] [MONTH] [Y] if you know 1 Jan [Y] is [DAY]?
templates.explanation: Count total days from Jan 1 to the given date, subtract 1, find mod 7, add to Wednesday.
